unit.why: A series of numbered teachings and verse interpretations by R. Itzikl of Radvil, collected from earlier books; item (ד) is only a question-and-answer exchange with the Seer of Lublin about pride, with no real narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the collection of sayings ('חידושים ומאמרים') begun at the end of the previous division, and goes on in the next division with item (י).
